producer: webpack --mode production --config-name webviews:common --config-name webviews --env analyzeBundle --env quick
budgetRationale: Re-baselined for Review Changes carrying across history rewrites and stepping through files not yet viewed (#116): +17.4 KiB on the entrypoint against the merge-queue pin, all of it graph.js (+20.5 KiB) while shared.js shrank 1.5 KiB and graph.css 1.6 KiB. Of that, +6.6 KiB had already accrued on main since the merge-queue pin (main measured 3,237,665 bytes at 9029768, inside its ceiling; 2e2557e adds no graph bytes) and +10.8 KiB is this change, all graph.js: remapping a review scope onto rewritten commits by patch id, subject and position; holding the scope while the remap runs and scrolling the picker to it after; moving commit and comparison reviews onto their rewritten commits, deferred while the review is busy; re-selecting the moved commit in the graph; the reading controls that skip viewed files, with Alt+click stepping in list order; the scope picker tooltip that tells a commit's line counts from its file count; and their localized messages. Not a new dependency or a module moving between chunks. Before it: GitHub merge-queue support (+11.7 KiB) on top of review mode as a review session (+72.8 KiB, see their commits). Ceilings keep their prior headroom: 12 KiB above baseline on the entrypoint, 4 KiB on shared.js (loaded by every webview), and graph.css's accounted allowance.
